# Delivery Handoff: Title

## Outcome Delivered

State whether the accepted user outcome was delivered.

## User-Visible Behavior

Describe what changed in plain language.

## Important Decisions

List consequential choices and link any ADRs.

## Files Changed

Group the meaningful files by responsibility; omit generated noise.

## Verification Evidence

| Check | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Acceptance criteria | Pass/Fail | What was observed |
| Automated checks | Pass/Fail/Unavailable | Exact commands and results |
| Manual journeys | Pass/Fail/Not run | Viewports/devices and cases |
| Independent review | Pass/Findings | Reviewer and resolution |

## Remaining Risks And Uncertainty

State unresolved risk, missing coverage, assumptions, or external conditions explicitly.

## CEO Decisions Required

List only decisions that meet the escalation threshold. Otherwise state `None`.

## Recommended Next Action

Give one concrete next step and why it is the best use of attention.
